title: ISS cabin temperature, humidity and CO2 during Rodent Research 5 (SpaceX-11), June to August 2017
documentation: https://visualization.osdr.nasa.gov/eda/static/js/telemetry_plots.js (units used by the portal: co2 ppm, temperature degrees C, rh %)
mission: RR-5, Rodent Research 5 (SpaceX-11). Portal note: 'For this release, the ground dates have been matched to the flight dates.'
instrument: EDA 'ISS' and 'Ground' channels as labeled by the portal; the cabin node, sensor and calibration are not given in the payload.
cadence: Mostly 300 s (19,107 of 19,159 intervals; the others 180, 240 and 360 s).
timestamp_timezone: Not stated in the payload; not assumed UTC.
preprocessing: The nested JSON telemetry embedded in the dashboard page (script id 'data', key telemetry_data) written to CSV with the same script and column order as eda_rr1_telemetry.csv; that script reproduces eda_rr1_telemetry.csv byte for byte (sha256 2d03645b...). No imputation, interpolation, time zone or ppm-to-mmHg conversion. The payload's milestone labels all sit on the first six timestamps, five minutes apart, so they carry no timing and are not kept. Source page sha256 6436d681b5bedda64474dcb39b90a4df3e886bf259cc42e18d1085800a49e605, 1,108,587 bytes.
license: US Government work. NASA material is generally not subject to copyright in the United States (NASA media usage guidelines, https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/). Credit NASA as the source; no NASA logo or insignia is used (NASA-SOURCES.md section 4).
provenance_note: REPLAY of recorded NASA OSDR EDA telemetry, shown with its 2017 dates.
is_not: Another mission's cabin in 2017, never a crew member's exposure.
ppm, not mmHg: converting needs cabin pressure, which the file does not have (NASA-SOURCES.md section 2 states the 760 mmHg assumption).

consumers.component: simulators/habitat CO2, temperature and humidity feeds
consumers.use: Second REPLAY profile: a nominal 2017 cabin whose highest trailing one-hour CO2 mean is 3,916 ppm (computed, README), just under 3 mmHg (3,947 ppm at an assumed 760 mmHg). It is the near-limit, no-warning counterpart of RR-1.
Negative control: replaying it must not raise the CO2 one-hour warning; RH up to 73% exercises the humidity band.
Station profile scenario with no expected warning.
